name: Printables (Etsy / Gumroad Digital Downloads)

yield.notes: Etsy charges listing fee ($0.20) + transaction fee (6.5%). High-volume stores with 100+ listings earn more.

flags: Etsy fee structure: 6.5% transaction + listing fees
Market saturated in popular niches (wedding, baby shower)

startup_checklist: Open Etsy seller account and Gumroad (dual-list for diversification)
Research trending printable niches using Everbee or Alura tools
Create first 10 designs: planners, checklists, wall art, trackers
Write SEO-optimized titles and tags for each listing
Run Etsy ads ($1/day budget) for first 30 days to gather data
failure_modes: Designs get copied by other sellers
Etsy search algorithm buries new listings
High refund/complaint rate damages shop ranking
kill_criteria: Less than 10 sales after 60 days with 20+ listings
Etsy suspends shop for policy violation
sources_note: Fee structure from Etsy official seller documentation.
